title: Article 3 Article 3  (1) The enjoyment of private rights commences at birth.
statute_text:
Article 3 Article 3  (1) The enjoyment of private rights commences at birth.
(2) Unless otherwise prohibited by applicable laws, regulations, or treaties, foreign nationals enjoy private rights.
Section 2 Mental Capacity
